articleTitle: Overview and Prospect of GNSS Anti-spoofing Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Global navigation satellite system (GNSS) has been widely used in various fields with potential security risks in GNSS applications. We briefly describe the causes of GNSS vulnerability and introduce typical navigation deception attacks. We also point out that satellite navigation spoofing interference is more harmful. The background and significance of GNSS anti-spoofing technology are stated to classify and summarize the means and measures of anti-spoofing technology in recent years. Finally, the advantages and disadvantages of current anti-spoofing technology are summarized to discuss the future research direction of anti-spoofing technology.

articleTitle: Machine Learning to Identify Bitcoin Mining by Web Browsers
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: In the recent development of the online cryptocurrency mining platform, Coinhive, numerous websites have employed “Cryptojacking.” They may need the unauthorized use of CPU resources to mine cryptocurrency and replace advertising income. Web cryptojacking technologies are the most recent attack in information security. Security teams have suggested blocking Cryptojacking scripts by using a blacklist as a strategy. However, the updating procedure of the static blacklist has not been able to promptly safeguard consumers because of the sharp rise in “Cryptojacking kidnapping”. Therefore, we propose a Cryptojacking identification technique based on analyzing the user's computer resources to combat the assault technology known as “Cryptojacking kidnapping.” Machine learning techniques are used to monitor changes in computer resources such as CPU changes. The experiment results indicate that this method is more accurate than the blacklist system and, in contrast to the blacklist system, manually updates the blacklist regularly. The misuse of online Cryptojacking programs and the unlawful hijacking of users' machines for Cryptojacking are becoming worse. In the future, information security undoubtedly addresses the issue of how to prevent Cryptojacking and abduction. The result of this study helps to save individuals from unintentionally becoming miners.

articleTitle: Quadruped Robot Foot-end Trajectory Generation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: In the movement of a quadruped robot, gait is an important feature, and the planning and control of gait cannot be separated from the planning of foot-end trajectory. A bionic impact-free foot-end trajectory for a quadruped robot is proposed in this study by combining the foot-end workspace and joint space. First, the trajectory of the foot-end of the swing phase is planned in three sections: back swing, stride, and forward swing. The back and forward swings adopt quintic polynomial curves, and the stride adopts a cycloid curve. Then, the planned foot-end trajectory is interpolated in equal-time intervals, and the obtained interpolated values are converted to joint interpolation by inverse kinematics. Finally, the angular velocity and angular acceleration at the joint interpolation are estimated by the difference quotient estimation method, and the joint space trajectory is planned using a quintic polynomial. The simulation experiments show the smooth curves of the foot trajectory and joint trajectory obtained by the algorithm planning, and the initial and final velocity and acceleration are zero. Meanwhile, the velocity and acceleration changes of the trajectory are continuous without sudden changes. After interpolation, the foot-end trajectory is restored completely while reducing the calculation.

articleTitle: Analysis of Digital Pattern Generation Technology Based on Fractal Graph
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Nowadays, with open information and the development of digital technology, designers combine computer and graphic designs. The powerful computing power of computers can transform previously inexpressible graphic ideas into reality and replace manual labor to improve design productivity. Due to the randomness and uncontrollability of graphics, the application of fractal graphics in design is mostly limited. Therefore, practice is conducted through generative and exploratory design methods to discuss the theory of fractal generation technology and basic composition methods and simulates them. The research proves that the fractal graph automatically generated by the computer breaks the thinking of traditional graphic design, broadens the field of graphic design, and promotes the development of the digital graphic design. More importantly, the computer helps designers visualize the interpretation of many rational theorems, and the design method can be profoundly changed.

articleTitle: Recognition System of Multi-model Chest X-Ray Diseases Based on YOLO v4
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: We use three models to build and design a multi-model identification system, and the identification results between the models are verified to increase accuracy. The identified lung diseases are classified into four categories, namely Normal, COVID-19, Tuberculosis, and Viral Pneumonia cases. After the user uploads the chest X-ray image, the system displays the results of the three identification types, and the calculation time is about 5 to 10 s. The accuracy of the multi-model system is better than that of the single-model system. If the Normal cases are included, the specificity is 77.41% for the traditional single-model system and 89.81% for the multi-model system. Additionally, if Normal cases are excluded, the F1 score is 70.00% for the single-model system and 80.7% for the multi-model system. Compared with the neural network with Faster R-CNN F1-Score of 90%, Mask R-CNN F1-Score of 85% and resNet-50 F1-Score of 80% are obtained.

articleTitle: Research on Improving Accuracy of Respiratory Sensing Based on CSI Ratio
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: In the past few years, respiration monitoring using Channel State Information (CSI) from commodity WiFi devices has shown great potential. However, existing methods require close-range detection and suffer from low accuracy and blind spots. In this study, we collect CSI data and real respiratory signal datasets in the environment of weak multipath effect and propose an improved CSI ratio model-HighSensing. For m x n WiFi devices, the perceived respiration rate is obtained by averaging m x <tex>$n$</tex> estimated respiration rates, which makes full use of link response information to improve the accuracy of the algorithm. Through experiments, we verify the effectiveness of the improvement in which the accuracy of the algorithm increases from 99.2 to 99.7%.

articleTitle: SAR Image Change Detection based on Multi-scale Feature Guided Residual CNN
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: This paper presents a multiscale feature-guided residual convolutional neural network (ResCNN) method for synthetic aperture radar (SAR) image change detection. The proposed method uses four convolutional kernels of different sizes to extract multi-scale features and fuses the features to make the representation more powerful. In addition, the proposed method introduces three residual blocks to form a CNN with more than ten layers. The deep network with residuals can ensure that the model can extract robust high-level semantic features from the image and avoid the gradient dispersion problem in backpropagation. The proposed method uses pseudo labels to guide network training, which is unsupervised. Visualize and quantify results for the real SAR data sets show that the depth network and multi-scale features help improve the model's change detection performance.

articleTitle: Research on Gesture Recognition Algorithm Based on Lightweight YOLOv4
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of a large number of parameters and low detection speed of the gesture recognition model based on the YOLOv4 algorithm, a lightweight object detection algorithm n-YOLOv4 was proposed in this study. Firstly, GhostNet was used to replace the YOLOv4 backbone feature extraction network, and deep separable convolution was used to replace the <tex>$3\times 3$</tex> conventional convolution of the non-backbone feature extraction network, which reduced the number of parameters in the model. Secondly, the CSC structure was used to replace part of the <tex>$1\times 1$</tex> conventional convolution in the network to expand the receptive field of the network. Finally, residual edges and quintic convolution modules were added to enhance the feature extraction capability of the PANet structure. In addition, the idea of transfer learning was introduced in the training process to save training time, and the data enhancement method was used to improve the generalization of the model. The experimental results showed that when the detection accuracy was only slightly affected, the weight file size decreased by 76.72 %, and the FPS increased by 10.85 %. This method provides a new idea for the research of gesture recognition algorithms.

articleTitle: Applying Particle Swarm Optimization in Scheduling Modular Software Testing Projects
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Software testing and debugging works aim to improve software quality in the hope of increasing software stability and user satisfaction. However, in practice, software testing work must be completed within a limited time and reach an acceptable reliability level, so project managers must know how to allocate and arrange the specified testing resources among all the software subsystems. However, most of the studies regarding the issue of software reliability have mainly focused on a whole software system or a simple series of software modules and might neglect the issue of testing complex and parallel software modules. Therefore, in this study, the two programming models are proposed to deal with the schedule of testing complex and parallel software modules to achieve a minimal testing time under the limited testing resources and certain reliability requirements. Moreover, Particle Swarm Optimization is used to solve such an NP-complete problem. It assists the software development managers in scheming and arranging all the testing resources in optimization under the related constraints.

articleTitle: Using Delphi -Fuzzy to Construct a Multi-attribute Decision-making Model for the Effectiveness of Rural Revitalization and Development
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: The economic system in rural is experimenting with different developments and innovations in China. For the packaging and marketing of agricultural products with regional cultural characteristics through the network platform, emphasis is placed on the value of regional cultural characteristics, eco-tourism, and the multi-industry promotion of online live broadcasts. Let the rural revitalized economy present a new development model. This paper mainly collects and analyzes literature, and uses two methodologies, the Delphi method, and fuzzy logic theory, to establish a multi-attribute decision-making model for analyzing the effectiveness of rural revitalization and development, which provides scientific and theoretical support for the research.

articleTitle: Application of K-subgraph Algorithm in Network Privacy Protection
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: In view of the social network privacy protection issues, a new privacy protection method - k - subgraph division rules is proposed through the social network segmentation and generalization vertex labels. The figure structure characteristics are disrupted to anonymize the social network and achieve the purpose of privacy protection. Simulation experiments show that this method offers a network with individual privacy protection, and availability is guaranteed for an anonymous social network at the same time.

articleTitle: Performance Conversion Rate of Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cells
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) is one of a kind high efficiency with hydrogen acts as a reducing agent and oxygen (air) acts as an oxidant a clean electrochemical power generation device that can directly convert the chemical energy of the fuel into electricity and is not limited by the Karnot cycle effect, so it has a high energy conversion rate (40%-60%). PEMFC units do not contain mechanical motion elements, so they work reliably, require less maintenance, and operate quietly and quietly. The influencing factors limiting the performance conversion rate of PEMFC are mainly: activation polarization, ohmic polarization, and concentration polarization. First, activation polarization: The main factor affecting the FC voltage in the low current density region is activation polarization. The activation polarization phenomenon is mainly due to the wonder of the electrode electrochemical reaction delay caused by its potential deviation from the equilibrium potential. Second, ohmic polarization: As the current density increases, ohmic polarization loss gradually dominates. This is mainly due to the voltage loss caused by the current collector plate, the contact resistance between the membrane electrode assemblies, etc. Third, the concentration difference polarization: when the current density reaches a specific value, the gas concentration polarization will cause the voltage to drop sharply, and the current value reaches the current limit density. Therefore, the transport efficiency of the reactant gas in the high current density region is an important factor affecting the fuel cell, and the flow channel layout is the key to affecting the reactant gas and the active area of the cell, improving the diffusion efficiency of the reactant gas and enhancing the drainage performance of the cell.

articleTitle: Applying System Dynamics Approach for Optimizing Software Release Decisions
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Improving software quality is one of the most important purposes for software developers and engineers, and improving software stability is the best way to increase user satisfaction. However, faced with the pressure of the schedule of software release and the constraints of testing cost, software developers have to make appropriate trade-offs between the goals of software quality and testing cost. However, traditional studies based on software reliability growth models are complex and difficult to apply to complex software testing environments. Therefore, to avoid the difficulty of mathematical derivation and to make it easier to apply to complex software testing environments, a system dynamics approach is applied to develop a software reliability growth model. The purpose is to establish the causal loop model for adapting complex software testing situations. The effects of testing and debugging on software reliability growth are effectively prevented by defining a causal loop diagram and related rules to proceed with system simulations. In addition, we provide a practical application that allows decision-makers for software development to apply the research method to improve the planning of software testing projects.

articleTitle: Secure and Efficient Gossip Learning with Adversarial Nodes
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Gossip learning is one of the most advanced approaches in decentralized techniques and performs almost as well as centralized training. However, gossip learning is inherently vulnerable to malicious attacks from adversarial nodes due to its flat architecture, which leads to performance degradation of collaborative training nodes. To reduce the negative impact of adversarial nodes, we propose an effective strategy to protect the distributed training process. The results show that the proposed strategy is robust to malicious attacks.

articleTitle: Real-time Risk Assessment and Game Collision Avoidance System of Fishing Boats in Near Waters under GPSone Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: At present, the existing Marine fishing boat danger monitoring system generally has many defects, such as extremely high construction cost, serious signal loss and high user use cost, and the use of the system is limited. With the development of GPSone positioning technology and the popularization of mobile phones, this article proposes a research scheme based on real-time risk assessment and game collision avoidance system of fishing boats under GPSone communication, expounds the optimization algorithm for navigation data prediction with non-stationary characteristics, construction and optimization of dynamic database of fishing boats, and gives the overall research route. The research scheme presented in this article lays a foundation for the concrete realization of the system, and also provides a new idea for the actual project development of risk evaluation and collision avoidance of fishing boats in the near sea area.

Author Keywords: Fishing Boat Risk Assessment and Collision Avoidance

articleTitle: Novel Visual Odometry Method for Water Autonomous Navigation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: A special VO algorithm designed for the inland river environment is proposed to improve the performance. Firstly, the statistical properties of the feature of a typical maritime scene are collected and analyzed for the survival time and reprojection error at different areas in the image. Then, a water-shoreline detection (WSD) algorithm is adopted to divide the scene into two parts, i.e., water area and non-water area, discarding unstable features of the water surface. Finally, the Visual Odometry (VO) method is customized to generate navigation trajectories. The results demonstrate that this method is robust, and WSD improves the accuracy of trajectory estimation.

Index Terms: Root Mean Square Error Of Cross-validation

articleTitle: Picture In Picture Detection For Mobile Captured Digital Video
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Along with the popularization of high-speed internet and high-performance digital cameras, the consumption prosperity of high-resolution videos and pictures appears. However, high-performance cameras bring about content infringes through illegal videotaping, which greatly damages the privileges and benefits of the content owners. Multimedia forensics is one of the most important copyright protection tools. In present forensic technologies, picture-in-picture detection is an important pre-processing step. In this study, a three-step picture-in-picture detection method is designed to effectively find the region of recaptured video. The region location is simply obtained from the I-frames after a rough detection and a fine-tuning step. Experimental results proved the effectiveness of the proposed work.

articleTitle: Study of Grey Relational Generating and Development of Toolbox by C Language
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Through the review of related studies of grey relational generating, we aim to present the five methods of grey relational generating and describe the whole mathematics calculation steps in detail. Based on the large data calculation and analysis, we also create a C language toolbox for the calculation and verification of a large number of complex numerical values. Two real examples such as drinking water and transportation are evaluated by using a computer toolbox to verify the final results. After actual calculation and analysis, the overall content of grey relational generation is verified to enhance the completed grey system theory.

articleTitle: Hybrid Model Based on Isolated Forest and WT-Catboost for Wind Power Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: A hybrid model based on isolated forests (IF), wavelet transform (WT), and categorical boosting (CatBoost) is proposed for wind energy prediction. In this prediction method, IF is first utilized to catch outliers in the raw wind power time series. Afterward, WT is applied to decompose the wind power sequence processed by outlier detection into several frequencies with more pleasing silhouettes. Finally, CatBoost is employed to learn the nonlinear attributes of these frequencies. The hybrid model is demonstrated on actual wind farm operation data and shows its effectiveness compared with other methods.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Approach to Selective Measurements of Hydrogen for Catalytic Gas Sensors
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: The results of research to improve hydrogen measurement selectivity of catalytic gas sensors are presented. The method uses temperature modulation to obtain the multidimensional signal, which includes a temperature-dependent sensor response to the presence of different gases in the environment: hydrogen, methane, ethylene, propane, butane, and hexane. The signal processing was performed using machine learning methods. Two models were trained: the linear regression and the neural network. The neural network model showed substantially better accuracy in comparison to the linear one. The absolute mean error for this model is 0.0095 %vol. The level of error is consistent for all gases. The results show that the presented method allows the selective measurements of target gases, hydrogen in particular, and minimize the interference of other gases. In comparison to other methods, the method does not need any changes in the sensor construction and allows selective results even when gases have a strong response to similar temperatures.

articleTitle: Security Analysis Using Network Authentication on the University Campus
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: The campus network has grown popular in today's society since the 21st century has ushered in the “information era”. Information has replaced money as a fundamental social and economic growth force. The campus network, which consists of network hardware, computers, and software, is the collaborative network of all auxiliary equipment used in the college and campus. The school campus uses the large-scale integrated application system of the office for processing student status information, teacher and student scientific research, school management, and teacher-student communication. Campus networks are an essential component of schools and universities. In classes, students must connect to the campus network to socialize and communicate. Students may play games on the school network to strengthen their bonds with their peers or use the university network to watch dramas. The school library is linked to online reading to save time and effort. During lectures, lecturers may also quickly manage students, readily gather information about each student, and easily control each student's computer over the campus network. These define the campus network's purpose and function. The campus network is a broadband multi-media network that gives professors, and students access to instruction, scientific research, and comprehensive information services. It is a requirement for campus digitization and digitization instruction. The campus network must have security for better use.

articleTitle: Online Rate Prediction of Transmission Line Monitoring Equipment Based on Q-learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: We present a method for the online rate prediction of transmission line monitoring equipment based on the Q-learning algorithm. The online rate prediction of monitoring equipment is modeled as a standard Markov decision process, and the advantage of the Q-learning algorithm is applied to realize the real-time prediction of the online rate. The effectiveness of this method is shown by the test results with the online rate data of the field operation equipment. In addition, the experimental part further verifies the influence of the relevant parameters of the algorithm on experimental performance.

articleTitle: Hand Motion Detection Based on Surface Electromyography Signals From A Single Wearable Sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: A hand gesture detection method using surface electromyography (sEMG) signals is presented in this paper. In the proposed work, we collect sEMG signals with a single wearable sensor, then extract the time-domain and frequency-domain features, and perform hand motion classification using a carefully designed classifier. Hand movements such as raising hands, turning hands sideways, holding mice, and clenching fists are recognized with the proposed method in real-time. The proposed method is valuable in smartwatches to improve users' experience in MR interactions and metauniverse application scenarios.

articleTitle: Adaptive Grey Wolf Optimizer for Global Numerical Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: As a well-regarded GWO variant, the improved Grey Wolf Optimizer (IGWO) is proven competitive in solving global numerical optimization problems due to its new proposed dimension learning-based hunting (DLH) search strategy. However, the high computational complexity of IGWO limits its potential application prospect. In this paper, a novel adaptive grey wolf optimizer with DLH (AGWO-D) is proposed to alleviate the heavy computational complexity of IGWO. The AGWO-D benefits from an execution probability model for each search agent to adopt the DLH search. By this mechanism, the search areas with more potential are more likely to be exploited, and thus the computational resources are used with higher efficiency. To evaluate the performance of the proposed AGWO-D algorithm, a simulation experiment is run on the CEC 2014 benchmark suite. And the experimental results show that, compared with IGWO, the AGWO-D algorithm has superior search capability with less computational time.

articleTitle: Simulation and Performance Analysis of Bridge Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Network simulator version 2 (NS2) is used to simulate the bridge monitoring system, and the simulation results are analyzed. The impact of performance evaluation has no unified standard. Based on the simulation of transmission delay, delay jitter, and so on, the advantages of the three routing protocols are compared to explain different bridge environments through comparison. The analysis results show that in the Ad hoc on-demand distance vector routing (AODV) of the delay, bandwidth is more sensitive to a greater degree of destination-sequenced distance vector (DSDV) and dynamic source routing protocol (DSR), which is determined by the characteristics of the routing protocol. The process of establishing a route before each data transmission requires a certain bandwidth, so in the case of insufficient bandwidth, a time delay is significantly larger than that of DSDV and DSR in the resource. Then, the routing setup process becomes significantly faster, and the three routing protocols become close to delaying.

articleTitle: Bridge Wireless Sensor Network for Disaster Tolerance Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: In NS2 network simulation, a bridge wireless ad hoc sensor monitoring network with 6kbps production from dynamic sensor nodes is examined. Three routing algorithm packet loss rates under different wireless bandwidths are analyzed using AODV, DODV, and DSR. The results show the following. With 1Mbps wireless bandwidth, the AODV routing algorithm is suitable for the bridge of small-scale wireless ad hoc sensor monitoring networks. To improve the capability of disaster tolerance, the sink node monitoring center needs to be used. With 2 Mbps wireless bandwidth, the performance of DSR routing algorithm is significantly better than other algorithms. With greater than 2 Mbps wireless bandwidth, the network bandwidth requires a two times larger flow of data as bandwidth increases, and the performance of the three routing algorithms is consistent.

articleTitle: Automatic Method for Red Spider Detection in Images
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: We present a fast and efficient automatic red spider detection method, namely RS-AD, by filtering out target samples containing red spiders from massive amounts of images on the internet. In the proposed RS-AD, the foreground objects are extracted by an image segmentation algorithm. Then, the classification procedure based on the areas and the shapes of the foreground objects is performed to identify the images containing red spiders. The performance of the proposed RS-AD is investigated in the classification test on a dataset containing images collected by the web crawler from the internet. The experimental result shows that the proposed RS-AD is capable of identifying the images containing red spiders with high accuracy and precision.

articleTitle: Unbiased Grey Model Combined with Artificial Intelligent Prediction Models
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: We propose the modified residual method based on the unbiased Grey Model (GM(1,1)) combined with the Auto-Regressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) and backpropagation neural network (BPNN). The model adopts BPNN when describing the nonlinear characteristics of the curve, and the GM-ARIMA model, which is widely used in linear time series prediction. Specifically, the BPNN model is used to simulate the curve and extract the nonlinear characteristics. Then, the residuals generated by the nonlinear model contain only linear features. Next, the GM-ARIMA model is applied to fit the residuals to extract the linear features. A Hybrid prediction model based on BPNN and GM-ARIMA models has the predicted values of the BPNN model combined with the predicted values of the residuals that are fitted by the GM-ARIMA model. In this research, the model enhances the local search ability of the genetic algorithm and avoids the neural network training falling into local minima. The results show that the improved GM-ARIMA and GM-BPNN model have strong searchability, improve accuracy, and shorten the training time. Finally, the application of the model and the prediction results are described by example tests.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Framework for Enterprise Profits Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: In recent years, “Internet +” has become a development trend. The profits of enterprises are forecasted based on their financial data for predicting their real operating conditions of them. We use machine learning algorithms commonly used in time series data to put forward an optimal machine learning framework and predict enterprise profits according to different enterprise industries.
